item.title: LOT-098: Giphy REST client (search, trending)
item.body:
LOT-098
Closes #190
Claim: ext/francoisgn-lot-098
Author model: Claude Sonnet 5.5

**Problem.** Legacy GIF search used the closed Giphy SDK with an embedded key; the engine has no GIF client.

**Change.** `GiphyClient` in HFRNetwork over `HTTPTransport` (default `AnonymousTransport`): `search` and `trending` on Giphy's public REST API, rating R by default as legacy, typed `GiphyError`. `GiphyConfiguration(baseURL:apiKey:)` is injected (ADR 0007); a blank key is `notConfigured`. No SDK, no package, no `HFRModels` change. Requests go to the injected host only, with no cookie and `doNotFollow` redirects; the search text is the only user data. The decoder reads only what `T40`/`T41` show. Docs: LOT-071 T5 now "kept: REST API, no SDK, notice N1, search terms only", spec `LOT-098-giphy-client.md`, HFR-PROTOCOL §6c `### LOT-098`.

**Why this wide.** One client, its result types (kept in HFRNetwork) and docs; the picker is LOT-155.

**Tests.** `GiphyClientTests` (21): requests as data (path, query, rating, key last, no cookie/Referer, no redirect, default transport is cookie-less), decoding of `T40`/`T41`, dropped items, error mapping, key stripped from errors, blank key. Mutations shown to fail: `.follow` redirect, non-anonymous default transport, unsanitized `httpStatus` URL, non-https URL accepted, blank key accepted. `swift test` (1656) green locally, `check-lot-deps.py` 0 violations, swiftlint --strict and markdownlint clean on changed files.

**PENDING CAPTURE.** A Giphy error answer; a media URL fetched without its query (the `cid` in the captured URLs is derived from the API key: `originalURLWithoutTracking` is provided, `originalURL` is the verified form).

---

comments.body:
Walkthrough

This change adds a configurable Giphy REST client for search and trending GIFs. It defines request bounds, typed errors, GIF and pagination models, and response decoding. Mock-transport tests and documentation cover the client behavior and the recorded decision to keep GIF search. **Changes: Giphy REST client** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Configuration and result contracts**
`Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRNetwork/Giphy/GiphyConfiguration.swift`, `GiphyError.swift`, `GiphyGIF.swift`, `GiphyRating.swift`|Configuration validates the base URL and API key. New public types represent errors, GIF results, pages, and ratings.| |**Request and response flow**
`Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRNetwork/Giphy/GiphyClient.swift`, `GiphyResponse.swift`|The client builds bounded search and trending requests, handles transport and HTTP failures, and decodes response bodies while skipping malformed items.| |**Tests and documented behavior**
`Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRNetworkTests/Giphy/*`, `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-071-third-party-services.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-098-giphy-client.md`|Mock-transport tests cover configuration, request policy, decoding, and errors. The protocol and LOT documents describe the client and record GIF search as kept through the REST API.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant GiphyClient participant GiphyConfiguration participant HTTPTransport participant GiphyResponse GiphyClient->>GiphyConfiguration: Build endpoint URL and query GiphyClient->>HTTPTransport: Send GET request HTTPTransport-->>GiphyClient: Return HTTP response GiphyClient->>GiphyResponse: Decode response body GiphyResponse-->>GiphyClient: Return GiphyPage or nil ``` **Possibly related issues** - Issue 324 — Tracks LOT-098 and the dependent LOT-155 GIF picker; this change implements the Giphy client. - Issue 245 — Describes the LOT-155 picker’s dependency on search and trending from LOT-098; this change provides that client while the picker remains separate. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#539](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/539) — Provides the Giphy search and trending captures used for response decoding and tests. - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257) — Adds the response-body size limit contract used by the client.
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to e4431

This adds an isolated Giphy REST client with tests and documentation, and no consumer uses it yet. No merge-blocking risk was identified. The macOS CI jobs run only once the PR is marked ready for review.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to e4431

The integration has a bounded design with anonymous requests, disabled redirects, validated configuration, and typed errors. No confirmed security vulnerability was established. Production configuration and an exceptional error-redaction path remain unverified, so the assessment is not minimal risk. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The immediate exposure is the caller-supplied API key and search text sent to the configured API origin. The entrypoints do not accept destination URLs or forum identities. Media URLs are returned as data, not fetched or posted by this client, so broader downstream media exposure is not established by this change. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _inferred_ — The deferred error-redaction candidate does not establish a reachable key leak. Its exceptional fallback does not explicitly strip query data, but the default transport returns HTTP statuses as responses and maps ordinary transport failures to URL-free values. Whether a supported injected transport can supply a key-bearing URL that triggers the fallback remains unresolved. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Configuration rejects URL userinfo, query, fragment, and non-HTTPS destinations except HTTP localhost or 127.0.0.1. The default transport removes explicit cookies and disables cookie storage, caching, and credential storage. Requests select a no-follow session whose delegate refuses redirects, preventing redirect-based replay of the key on that path. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The new client stores immutable configuration and transport references and performs one read-only GET per invocation without adding retries, persistent state, or a multi-step ownership transition. Existing transport cancellation and deadlines contain request execution; failures do not initiate a client-managed recovery mutation. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — When activating the picker, explicitly own trusted destination configuration and anonymous transport selection, and settle media-host and tracking-query policy before fetching or publishing returned URLs. Verify query-free CDN behavior rather than treating the accessor alone as a completed privacy guarantee.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/opus-adv-541, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head 4fbbd651faa946832f39d0e2cc855ef3b4236df3

Round 1 findings (all Low/Nit), verbatim:

1. **Low**, `Giphy/GiphyConfiguration.swift:2`: the key can still be printed. `description` and `debugDescription` hide it, but `dump()` and `Mirror` show it. Fix: add `CustomReflectable` (base URL only) and a test, or say in the doc comment that only `description` is redacted.
2. **Nit**, `GiphyConfiguration.swift:36` and spec "Behaviour": both say `::1` is accepted, but on Linux `http://[::1]:8080` throws `invalidBaseURL` (probe). Either match a bracketed host or drop `::1` from the docs.
3. **Nit**, `GiphyConfiguration.swift:33`: the `parts.user == nil` check can be deleted and every test still passes. Add `https://u@api.giphy.com` to the refused list.
4. **Nit**, `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` §6c LOT-098: the captures sent `lang=en` and the client does not; mark the omission as unverified.
5. **Nit**, `GiphyResponse.swift:26`: media URLs are checked for `https` but not for host. LOT-155 should know a URL it posts or previews can point at any host, or this should be restricted to `*.giphy.com`.

**Checked:** full suite 1656 tests pass; mutations caught (`.follow`, key in `httpStatus` URL, `invalidRequest` reason, 3xx as success, non-anonymous default transport, http/javascript media URLs, http base URL, unclamped limit); GET only, no retry/redirect/cookie/Referer/Authorization, `q` encoded; decoding tested on T40/T41 only; module boundaries and Swift 6 OK; LESSONS 1–56 reviewed; `Closes #190` / `Claim:` match.

Fixed in e4431a5 (with `dev-swift` merged): 1 (`CustomReflectable` + `dump` test), 2 (`::1` dropped from code and spec), 3 (test case added), 4 and 5 (documented; the host restriction is left to LOT-155).

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, cloud/opus-adv-541, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head e4431a569f51aedfc7aaa48dcc4909fe6f071032

Round 2, verbatim: all five round-1 findings are fixed, no new findings.

1. Key in `dump`/`Mirror`: fixed (`CustomReflectable`); removing it makes `theDescriptionNeverShowsTheKey()` fail.
2. `::1` loopback: removed from code and spec.
3. Username-only base URL: `https://u@api.giphy.com` is in the refused list; removing `parts.user == nil` makes `theBaseURLMustBeHTTPSOrLoopbackWithoutQueryOrUserinfo()` fail.
4. `lang` omitted: HFR-PROTOCOL §6c and the spec say the request without `lang` is unverified.
5. Media URL host: the spec says `https` only, not host; the `*.giphy.com` choice is left to LOT-155.

**Checked:** one round-2 commit; `origin/dev-swift` already an ancestor of the head; `swift test` 1656 tests pass on Linux; SwiftLint clean; both mutations reverted; worktree removed.
